symptom: After adding `Attribute: $dataView1.Name` (#826): `combobox cb (Attribute: $dataView1.Name)` checked clean and executed as "Created page" with no attribute at all (it had been a parse error), and a textbox reading through a SIBLING data view built earlier on the page was written and failed mx check 11.13.0 with CE7001 "Widget should be placed inside Data view 'dv1' to use it as a source widget".
cause: The new grammar alternative was accepted on every widget's `Attribute:`, but only the six input builders resolve the `$name.Attr` string — every other consumer resolved it to nothing. And the data-view registry the input builder consulted was page-global, never popped when the data view's children were done.
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_page_v3.go (widgetAttributeRefKinds refusal), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (registerDataViewVariable returns an unregister func), cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (defer it in buildDataViewV3)
insight: A grammar alternative added for one consumer opens the property for EVERY widget sharing the rule; enumerate who reads the property (the pluggable engine, dynamic text, columns) before widening it, and compare against origin/main's behaviour for the same input — here the old binary's parse error was the control that showed a silent drop had been introduced. A name registry for scoped references must be scoped like the reference: register on entry, restore on exit.
